nom: Black Girl Sunscreen Moisturizing Sunscreen Lotion SPF 30

avis.texte: I haven't bought a lot of sunscreen, so I have little to compare this against. But it goes on smoothly, leaves a nice glow with no white cast, and seems to work well. I use it on my body (and use another brand's SPF 30 facial lotion) with no issues.

i absolutely love this sunscreen because it goes on sheer without any white residue. I'm encouraged to use it regularly because of its consistency and lack of fragrancee. While I use the separate facial sunscreen by this manufacturer, my daughter uses this product on her face and body. I'm so pleased with this product that I plan to purchase other Black Girl Sunscreen items. . So glad that Ulta carries the complete line.
I absolutely love this sunscreen. It is moisturizing and feels great on the skin. This is my first time purchasing this sunscreen and I am glad I did.

I've used this sunscreen for 4 years, and I love the way it makes my skin look, I use it everyday, I consistently get compliments about my skin when I have this on. It definitely gives a glowy look. Would not recommend if you have oily skin. Pair with a good moisturizer.

First things first, when I put this on my face, it's so soothing. It's like a vanilla scented cooling lotion, it's refreshing. It smells amazing and the scent doesn't irritate my skin or my nose. It never leaves a white cast and it feels nourishing.

I have really sensitive skin and can not use most chemical sunscreen brands. I always do a few spot test and wait 48 hours before saying there was no reaction. I dab a little in various places on my body because your skin on your legs may be more sensitive than the skin on your arms. I check back periodically, and then at the end of the day shower and continue to monitor. Most of the times product will irritate my skin between 10 minutes to an hour later. I was surprised when this product made it past the one hour mark. And even more so after the full 48 hours passed. After the 48 hours passed without incident, I used the product as normal on my body and was surprised to see the added glow that came with it. No white cast, just my skin with a "I am covered in layers of moisturizer", without feeling heavy or greasey look. I do not ever use sunscreen that says for face and body on my face. I personally perfer a sunscreen that is made for the skin on my face. So, I cannot speak to how it performs on the face. TLDR: 1. Do spot tests for 24 -48 hours if you have sensitive skin before doing full application 2. Use facial sunscren for your face, ears and neck 3. Gives skin a pretty glow with zero white cast
